no_adcom_quote.quote: FDA did not hold an advisory committee meeting for these applications because no review issues were identified that raised significant public health questions regarding the risk:benefit assessment of larotrectinib for the proposed indication.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the larotrectinib (VITRAKVI) NDA because FDA identified no review issues raising significant public health questions about the risk:benefit assessment. In lieu of an AdComm, three special government employees (an adult oncologist, a pediatric oncologist, and a patient representative) were consulted individually by teleconference, and all indicated a favorable risk:benefit and no concerns regarding approval. Because no committee was held, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to labeling or postmarketing changes.
